debug_root_causes_resolved.BUG_1_U2_HORIZONTAL_MIRROR_FLIP_AND_SQUA: In v3.0, donor_u2 had its shoulder cannons slanting up-right (/), opposite to the scene's up-left (\) cannons, and `valid_eroded` was a solid 1024x1024 square that pasted the donor's square background wall over the scene. Fixed by E-SHQ-86 (Chirality & Structural Coherence Lock) and E-SHQ-88 (TUIDI Foreground-Only Masking in shq_object_extractor.py).
debug_root_causes_resolved.BUG_2_U1_PILOT_62PX_HORIZONTAL_OFFSET: In v3.0, U1_PILOT's donor landmark `right_eye` (x=468) was mistakenly matched to x=522 (+54px error), shifting the pilot 62px right and clipping her right shoulder. Fixed by exact landmark registration (wRMSE_1x = 0.61px) and bottom-up L3->L2->L1->L0 return.
debug_root_causes_resolved.BUG_3_MISSING_MODULAR_EXTRACT_AND_RETURN: Separated into two dedicated, self-consistent Python modules: `shq_object_extractor.py` (single-object TUIDI extraction & L1->L2->L3 decomposition) and `shq_recursive_layer_return.py` (bottom-up L3->L2->L1->L0 return & chirality anti-flip lock).
